title: GEMINI CLI - NON RIESCO A LOGGARMI

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports an authentication failure where the backend Google OAuth service returns the message: 'This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals.' This stems from an account setup/configuration and service deprecation issue rather than a systemic code defect within the gemini-cli codebase. Per the quality criteria, reports of setup or configuration failures without a systemic code defect must be classified as NEEDS_INFO.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug... The error message indicates that Gemini Code Assist for individuals is no longer supported for this client. Could you please clarify whether you are able to authenticate using a Gemini API Key or Vertex AI instead, or if you need assistance migrating to the Antigravity suite?
